Config.description: The set of repositories to scan for GitHub Actions workflow runs.

include_forks.description: Whether the repositories of each organization that are forks of another repository are scanned too. Forks listed under `repositories` are always scanned.

organizations.description: GitHub organizations (or users) whose public repositories are all scanned.

repositories.description: Individual repositories to scan, each written as `owner/name` so that the owner is never ambiguous. A repository also covered by one of the organizations is scanned once.
